minimum_rules.R: Customer charge for first 5 kVA installed or allocated transformer capacity plus $1.50 for each kVA above 5; one ordinary dwelling only in contemplated scope.
minimum_rules.SGS: Highest applicable minimum: ordinary customer charge for first 5 allocated kVA plus $1.50 per kVA above 5; unusual installations may carry separately contracted minimum charges/capacity. Seasonal disconnection does not avoid the twelve-month minimum. New extensions can require added facility or minimum charges.

eligibility.R: Individual single-family/home/farm single-phase service; ordinary 120/240 V, no shared meter/multiple dwelling, mixed use or special program in contemplated scope.
eligibility.SGS: Utility-confirmed non-residential SGS billing capacity below 50 kW; cooperative can reclassify based on historical usage. No demand price line in recovered SGS sheets, but historical assignment and any contractual minimum remain independent facts.
eligibility.motors: Single-phase individual motor limit 15 hp absent cooperative permission; cooperative can require motor-start controls.

billing_chronology.tariff_rules: Monthly or part thereof full consumer/minimum charges; estimated intervening readings and bimonthly billings permitted by the sheets, with applicable charges/blocks doubled for bimonthly service.
billing_chronology.rider_A: Applied commencing with bill rendered after effective date.
billing_chronology.rider_B_2025: Separate generation/transmission factors applied to total billed kWh on bills rendered on or after effective date October 1, 2025; factors determined monthly.
billing_chronology.sample: Service April 30-May 29, 2026; bill June 2, 2026; not matching calendar service/billing month. This sample alone does not establish all monthly factor applicability.

tax_observations_not_complete_bill.non_30_day_rule: Apply rates to daily average blocks: first 67 kWh/day, then through 500 kWh/day, remainder; multiply daily tax by days. Do not substitute 2000/15000 unchanged for non-30-day periods.
tax_observations_not_complete_bill.sales_tax: Electricity delivered through wires is exempt under current ORC 5739.02(B)(7); security-monitoring sample sales tax is unrelated.
tax_observations_not_complete_bill.Rider_A: No numeric complete locality/account impositions vector established. Ordinary status, local impositions, exemptions and self-assessor status require independent evidence.

DER_scope.ordinary_import_approval: Future support requires final written cooperative approval preserving ordinary import billing for the exact non-export PV or paired-storage installation, active before the service cycle, with all extra charges documented.
DER_scope.storage: PV-only charging and zero export; standalone/grid-charged storage not established.
DER_scope.export: No net metering, avoided-cost net billing or credit bank is implemented; zero-export configuration alone is not tariff/interconnection approval.
